comments:
Barrierewerk is a hosted online tool — nothing is installed locally, which is why the
operating system fields are left empty. The free scan needs no account, so you can test
it directly at https://barrierewerk.de.

Of the 56 WCAG 2.1/2.2 success criteria covered, 11 are evaluated automatically in a
headless Chromium browser; for the other 45 the tool produces a guided manual checklist.
Interface and reports are German only.
features: Barrierewerk checks websites against WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 (EN 301 549, German BFSG). A real browser renders up to five pages: 11 success criteria are tested automatically, the remaining 45 are presented as a guided manual checklist with plain-language instructions for checking and fixing. Free score report; detailed findings and PDF audit are paid.
title: Barrierewerk
